official_source: Google Drive file 1YgnKz3hnzD3umEYHAgd29n2AwedV1Jmg, linked as [Dataset] on the first author's homepage https://xiaoxiaosun.com/ (Sun et al., ECCV 2016); the project page http://cv.nankai.edu.cn/projects/sd-198/ returns HTTP 410
consequence: P7(a) SD-198 scores computed on the mirror are scores on the official release; no rescoring needed
licence: no licence stated by the authors; images originate from DermQuest (paper, Sec. 3)
